findings: todayCount timezone mismatch: commandes/page.tsx uses new Date().toDateString() (UTC on Cloudflare Workers) while the dashboard uses an Africa/Dakar anchor. Orders near midnight are miscounted. Fix: apply the same Dakar locale trick.

Unbounded IN clause in explorer/page.tsx: activeShopIds is materialized and interpolated into a raw SQL IN (...) template with no size cap. D1's bound-parameter limit (~100) will cause this query to fail once the catalogue grows beyond ~100 active shops. Replace with a JOIN-based subquery.

APP_URL is server-only: the fix commit renamed NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to APP_URL. Current callers are all Server Components so it works today, but .env.example no longer documents a NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL variant. Any future client component reading the base URL will silently get undefined.
